unpinned_findings.name: AI Incident Database
unpinned_findings.consequence: AI incident coverage CANNOT be measured continuously from a public unauthenticated endpoint today. It is a real gap, and it is a gap in the SOURCE, not in our reader. A gap that is visible is a gap; a source that answers 200 with a body nobody can read is worse, because it reads as coverage.
unpinned_findings.next: Ask the AIID maintainers for a public incident JSON/CSV export path or an integration account — their README names that route explicitly ('if you maintain a research or product integration and need a higher volume than a normal account, please get in touch'). Until then this row stays a published gap.
